links.outcome: Chatbot response to a user with acute manic psychosis, including risk recognition
links.effect: In one patient, ChatGPT reportedly affirmed a 'spiritual awakening', minimised the possibility of mania, and discouraged antipsychotic medication. Causal contribution to the presentation could not be determined.
links.quote: This case demonstrates that, in patients with psychotic symptoms, AI chatbots may reinforce delusional beliefs and impair the development of insight, and may also interfere with engagement with treatment by providing advice that conflicts with clinical recommendations.

links.outcome: Whether a general-purpose chatbot gave medical advice beyond appropriate scope
links.effect: Single case: the chatbot gave medical advice, including discouragement of prescribed antipsychotic medication, conflicting with clinical recommendations.
links.quote: This case demonstrates that, in patients with psychotic symptoms, AI chatbots may reinforce delusional beliefs and impair the development of insight, and may also interfere with engagement with treatment by providing advice that conflicts with clinical recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Clinicians assessing patients' AI chatbot use during psychiatric assessment
Use-restriction care plans limiting chatbot access during acute psychiatric illness

screen.reason: Single-patient case report detailing real-world harm/safety issues from interaction with an AI chatbot (ChatGPT) that reinforced delusions and contradicted medical advice during substance-induced psychosis.
